overview: Scoped harness for the Windows technician P00-P09 live-certification surface and its owned repair commands.

directories.purpose: Stage dispatcher, repair dispatcher, shared module, manifest, schemas, stage implementations, and report template.
Scoped maps, workflows, artifact policy, schema, and operator-report template.
Opt-in pre-commit validators; never installed implicitly.
Dependency-free Python contract and completeness tests.
Human-readable state, workflow, failure, and proof guidance.
Windows PowerShell 5.1, PowerShell 7, Linux, Python, CMD dry-run, and diff-hygiene CI.

entrypoints.purpose: Start a new run and prove workstation prerequisites.
Owned WSL/Ubuntu first-machine repair with reboot continuation.
Read-only JSON and English status report.

knownTraps: PSScriptRoot can be empty while a parameter default expression is evaluated in Windows PowerShell 5.1; resolve it in the script body.
System.String.Replace can bind to char,char when passed [char]0 and an empty string; force the string,string overload.
Hosted CI skips real WSL/Ubuntu runtime and cannot promote P00 workstation proof.
git diff may invoke an interactive pager; harness commands must use git --no-pager.
A stage may not pass from process creation alone; child exit, effective-state readback, and required observation remain mandatory.
Generated run evidence contains local account and path data and must remain untracked.
proofCeiling: Tracked harness structure, cross-shell parser and contract validation, fixture-safe CMD dispatch, local artifact policy, and exact failure-boundary reporting only. Live WSL initialization, visible WezTerm behavior, tmux attachment, agent launch, repeatability, and operator acceptance require the workstation live-cert sequence.
